run_constituency_parse_clozes: run constituency parsing on a list of cloze questions to extract syntactic tree structures
get_sub_clauses_from_sentence: get sub-clauses from a sentence using its constituency parse tree
shorten_cloze_question: shorten a cloze question by extracting syntactically valid sub-clauses
load_constituency_parser: load the AllenNLP constituency parser model for sentence parsing
get_root_type_from_tree: get the root label from a constituency parse tree string
